x: Don Stroud ran well to finish 56th and others who performed satisfactorily were S.Boreham,C.Shippen, J.Dooley and M.Robinson. Don McLean came all the way from Oxford by motor-cycle to finish 324th - perhaps the cold got into his bones, or is there some other reason for these continuous lapses from his real form?
The 'E' team had shot its bolt and had no runners on this stage. The fourth and last stages were run by M. Robinson(A) who did 24.14 to take us up to 8th, J.
Most notable of these were the 440 yds. win in 48·7s. by Clive Ryan - a new Championship record, and the mile win of Malcolm Robinson in which Jack Brown's long standing record only just survived.
For lap after lap, Pat Newell, the holder, Mal Robinson, our Mile Champion, and Jim Radford ran together; neither giving nor expecting quarter.
